entry_point: library API: compile/precompile with a pre-parsed template document (a JSON AST), its eager precompile form, and the exported compiler stages driven directly

verified.entry_point: The reported class of flaw reproduces at the pinned commit through Handlebars.compile/precompile with a pre-parsed AST. Each tested route was driven through a real public entry point: compile(AST) and precompile(AST), string-parameter mode, and new Handlebars.Compiler().compile(AST) followed by new Handlebars.JavaScriptCompiler().compile(env). All six markers ran on the pinned+injected tree and were blocked by the reference fix.
sites: lib/handlebars/compiler/compiler.js:103-118 (Program block parameter count read from the document)
lib/handlebars/compiler/compiler.js:411-453 (pushParam: depth, value and original read from every argument node; string-parameter mode)
lib/handlebars/compiler/javascript-compiler.js:594-607 and 1107-1113 (pushStringParam raw emission and contextName depth interpolation)
lib/handlebars/compiler/javascript-compiler.js:959-970 (programExpression writes the block parameter count raw)
lib/handlebars/compiler/compiler.js BigIntLiteral handler and javascript-compiler.js pushBigInt (injected whole-number literal sink)
lib/handlebars.js:20-32 exports the compiler stages that precompile assembles
routes: compile(AST) with a crafted block-parameter count (real upstream, published-fix site)
compile/precompile(AST, {stringParams:true}) with a text depth on a non-path argument node (real upstream, published-fix site)
compile(AST, {stringParams:true}) with a list value or list source text on an argument (real upstream, published-fix site)
the exported compiler stages driven directly, which never reach the parser-level check at the pinned commit (real upstream, untouched by the parser-level protection; Pattern B register row)
compile/precompile(AST) with whole-number literal text (our injected sibling)
compile(AST) with partial indentation text (our injected sibling)
injected_siblings: lib/handlebars/compiler/compiler.js BigIntLiteral handler + lib/handlebars/compiler/javascript-compiler.js pushBigInt: maintained whole-number literal type whose decimal text is concatenated with the `n` suffix (our copy; documented and typed)

lib/handlebars/compiler/javascript-compiler.js invokePartial: maintained partial indentation written into the generated options literal by manual quoting, assuming the whitespace pass supplies only spaces and tabs (our copy)
verified.services: none; offline after the image build
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own Mocha specs for the affected area and its neighbours run as pristine copies in the functional group: basic, blocks, partials, string-params, track-ids, security, ast, whitespace-control, subexpressions, data, strict, precompiler, helpers, regressions and runtime (497 cases); they pass on the pinned+injected tree and on the reference fix. spec/compiler.js is not graded because its four parser-check tests assert the superseded error strings and are replaced by the published fix; the image build still runs it at the pinned commit, where it passes.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the property is about what reaches generated code; a crash before emission leaves no side effect, and a crash on a legitimate document is caught by the functional tests
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the library has no resources or per-object authorization; the protected object is the generated code itself
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: no roles or directions exist; every caller of the public compilation entry points is treated the same
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: there is no read/write split; the flaw is in what the compiler emits, not in a stored change
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the only post-check adjustment is whitespace normalisation, which the partial-indent tests already cover; no numeric adjustment turns one bad value into another
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or credential value is involved
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority or permission server is consulted

traps.name: block-parameter count written into generated code
traps.shape: a program node whose parameter-count metadata is written raw as the third argument of the generated container.program(...) call
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit
traps.realistic_because_detail: the compiler stores the length of the document's block-parameter list and the generator interpolates it; only the published fix validates the list

traps.name: argument depth read from every node kind in source-text mode
traps.shape: a text depth carried by an argument node that is not a path, interpolated as depths[...] in string-parameter mode
coupled_functional_tests: string_params.test.js (number and boolean arguments keep their types)
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit
traps.realistic_because_detail: pushParam reads depth from whatever node it is given, while the parser-level check only validates path nodes

traps.name: argument value or source text emitted raw in source-text mode
traps.shape: a list supplied as an argument value or as its source text, emitted as a raw JavaScript literal by pushStringParam
coupled_functional_tests: string_params.test.js (source text normalisation and typed numbers/booleans)
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit
traps.realistic_because_detail: the generator emits any non-string argument value raw, and the compiler only validated literal node values for the ordinary (non source-text) path

traps.name: compiler stages bypass the parser-level check
traps.shape: the same crafted documents driven through the exported compiler stages instead of the convenience functions, where the pinned parser-level check never runs
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit
traps.realistic_because_detail: the published fix moves the checks into the compiler, so the stage route is covered by a fix at the right layer and left open by one that only extends the parser check

traps.name: whole-number literal text concatenated into code
traps.shape: a whole-number literal node whose decimal text is not an integer, concatenated with the n suffix into the generated expression
coupled_functional_tests: integer_literal.test.js (whole-number literals of any magnitude still reach helpers as integers)
traps.realistic_because: injected sibling written as a maintainer would: a new literal kind documented in docs/compiler-api.md and types/index.d.ts, emitted like the other literal kinds

traps.name: partial indentation written into the generated options literal
traps.shape: indentation text carried by a partial document, quoted by hand and concatenated into the generated options object
coupled_functional_tests: partial_indent.test.js (parsed and supplied indentation still render)
traps.realistic_because: injected sibling written as a maintainer would: the whitespace pass is the only producer of indentation for parsed templates, so the manual quoting looks safe
